senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. מוּט)to slip; (act. verb) to loosen, detach; to carry off, steal.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4">Num. R. s. 4<sup>20</sup></cite> (ref. to <cite ref="II Samuel 6:6">II Sam. VI, 6</cite>) <he>למה שָׁמְטוּ</he> why did they slip (turn off)? <cite ref="Moed Katan 24a:4">M. Kat. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>שמטו חזירים וכ׳</he> swine dragged his body off.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:1:7">Y. Ber. III, 5ᵈ</cite> bot., a. e. <he>שׁוֹמֵט וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="S01248"><he>קְלִבִּנְטִירִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:1:7">Ib.</cite> <he>מטה … שׁוֹמְטָן ודיו</he> in the case of a bed the poles of which are movable, one (in mourning) detaches them, and that is sufficient; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 7:5:2">Y. Ned. VII, end, 40ᶜ</cite> <he>שומטו</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 104a:13">B. Mets. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>שׁוֹמְטוֹ מעל גבי בניו</he> he may take it (the pledge) from the back of his (the debtor’s) sons.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 43">Ex. R. s. 43</cite> <he>והם שׁוֹמְטִים וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="I00280"><he>טֶטְרָאמוּלִי</he></cite>.
Y. Keth. V, 30ᵇ היתה שׁוֹמֶטֶת עצמה וכ׳ she slipped away from under him; Sot. 9ᵇ נִשְׁמְטָה (Nif.).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 14:4">Gen. R. s. 14</cite> <he>שׁוֹמְטָהּ</he>, v. <cite ref="R00808"><he>צָרַר</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 20:1">Pesik. R. s. 20</cite> <he>נִשְׁמוֹט אותה</he> let us abandon her (that she may not find her way home); <he>מיד שְׁמָטוּהָ</he> (not <he>שמוטה</he>) and so they abandoned her.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>יִשְׁמוֹט</he>, v. <cite ref="H01109"><he>חָלַץ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>שומט גידין וכ׳</he> it (the serpent) draws out fibres (v. <cite ref="C00626"><he>גִּיד</he></cite>) and eats them.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 114:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXIV</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 4:34">Deut. IV, 34</cite> <he>גוי מקרב גוי</he>) <he>כאדם ששומט את העובר וכ׳</he> as a man draws an embryo out of its mother’s womb.

<cite ref="Deuteronomy 4:34">Ib.</cite> <he>למדנו צער לנִשְׁמָט לשומט מנין</he> we learn here that there was pain for the body drawn out (Israel), whence do we learn that it was painful for him that drew out (for the Lord who redeemed them)?; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="U01430"><he>שָׁמוּט</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="U01431"><he>שְׁמוּטָה</he></cite>.

Ḥull. 54ᵃ ש׳ ושחוטה וכ׳ if the trachea was found detached, yet cut through, the animal is kasher; שא״א לש׳ וכ׳ for it is impossible that a loose trachea should be cut through (therefore the detachment must have taken place after the ritual cutting). Ib. 57ᵃ, a. e. שְׁמוּטַת ורך an animal with a dislocated thigh-bone; שמוטת וד with a dislocated foreleg; a. e.—V. שָׁמוּט.

senses.gloss: to be detached, slip away. Midr. Till. l. c., v. supra. Sot. l. c., v. supra.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 1">Num. R. s. 1<sup>8</sup></cite> <he>הר חורב שעליו נִשִׁמְטָה החרב וכ׳</he> it is named mount Horeb, because on it the sword (of judgment) was unsheathed (for crimes); (Yalk. ib. 684 <he>נמשכה</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 796">Yalk. Ps. 796</cite> <he>נמתחה</he>).

<cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 2:1">Macc. II, 1</cite>, v. <cite ref="S02278"><he>קַתְּ</he></cite>. Sifra Emor, ch. II, Par. 3 (expl. <he>שרוע</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 21:18">Lev. XXI, 18</cite>) <he>שנשמטה יריכו</he> (Rabad <he>שנשתרבבה</he>) whose hip is dislocated.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:16">Cant. R. to V, 16</cite> (<he>ממנו</he>) <he>נשמטה נפשו</he> his soul slipped away (from him), he fainted; a. fr.—[Tosef. ‘<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 1:2">Uktsin I, 2</cite> (Tbul Yom III) <he>נשמטין</he>, read with ed. Zuck. <he>נִכְסָסִין</he>.]

senses.gloss: to loosen, pluck, esp. to thin a thicket of reeds.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 1:7">Tosef. Shebi. I, 7</cite>; Y. ib. II, 33ᵈ top <he>מְשַׁמְּטִין בקנים</he> you may thin reeds (in the Sabbatical year); <he>מקום … ולְשַׁמֵּט וכ׳</he> where it is customary to clear vines and to thin reeds before &c.; a. e.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 17:1">Pesik. R. s. 17</cite> <he>ומְשַׁמְּטִים הבכורות מבין וכ׳</he> and the dogs dragged the dead bodies of the first-born out of the burial caves; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 186">Yalk. Ex. 186</cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: (v. שְׁמִטָּה) to cause release from debt; to cause cessation of field labor; (neut. verb) to come under the law of limitation of the Sabbatical year; (of the ground) to rest.
units: Shebi. X, 1 שביעית מְשַׁמֶּטֶת את המלוה וכ׳ the Sabbatical year causes cancellation of (cash) debts, whether verbal or written; הקפת … אינה משמטת, v. הַקָּפָה; שכר שכיר אינו מְשַׁמֵּט a hired man’s wages do not come under the law of sh’miṭṭah; ib. 2 המוסר … אינן משמטין (not אינו) if one hands his notes over to the court, they are not subject to the law of limitation; ib. האונס … וכל מעשה ב״ד אינן משמטין fines for outrage …, and all obligations arising from legal procedures do not come under the law &c.; ib. 3, v. פְּרוֹזְבּוֹל; [Y. ed. מַשְׁמִיט, מַשְׁמִיטִין &c. Hif. interch. with Pi.]. Sifra B’ḥuck., Par. 2, ch. VII אני אמרתי … ומשמטים לי אחת וכ׳ I have told you that you may sow six years, and let the ground rest for me one year, that you may know &c.; עמדו וגלו והיא תְשַׁמֵּט מאליה כל שמיטים וכ׳ go ye and be carried into exile, and it (the land) will rest of itself (making up for) all the Sabbatical years &c.; Yalk. Lev. 675 והיא תַשְׁמִיט מאיליה עד שתרצה לפני כל שמיטין וכ׳.

<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 38:4">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXXVIII</cite> <he>הואיל ואין אתם משמיטין אותה היא תְשַׁמֵּט אתכם</he> (ed. Schechter <he>ואי אתם משמטים את הארץ</he>) because you do not let the earth rest, she will abandon you; <he>ומספר ירחים שאי אתם משמיטין אותה היא תשמט מאליה</he> (ed. Schechter <he>שאין אתם משמטים</he>) and according to the number of months that you fail to let her rest, she will rest of herself.
<cite ref="Gittin 36a:14">Gitt. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>בזמן שאתה משמט … משמט כספים</he> when thou art bound to let the ground rest, thou art bound to cancel debts; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 97a:13">Snh. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>כשם שהשביעית משמטת … כך העולם משמט וכ׳</he> as the Sabbatical year causes cessation of field work once every seven years, so shall the world rest (be waste) one millennium in every seven millenniums.

<cite ref="Gittin 37b:1-3">Gitt. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>המחזיר חוב … יאמר לו משמט אני וכ׳</he> if a person pays a debt in the Sabbatical year, he (the creditor) must say, ‘I remit’ (and have no claim): but if he (the debtor) says, ‘nevertheless’, he may accept; <cite ref="Shabbat 148b">Sabb. 148ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 112">Sifré Deut. 112</cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to abandon, send away. Ab. d’R. N. l. c., v. supra.

units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:12">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 11</cite> <he>מִשְׁתַּמְּטוֹת</he>, v. <cite ref="I00521"><he>טֶלֶף</he></cite>.
